baseline_runtime: 32,768-token analyzer context, fixed 30 retained assistant turns, 22 workers, 6,480 seconds per game, strict cumulative action cap 14, PLU0, no replay, no reflection, persistent top-six curator

modes.control: exact champion model-facing prompts and evidence; new transition paths dormant
modes.metadata: compact action, total-frame, changed-frame, and sampled-index labels; legacy ASCII and region tools retained
modes.additive: metadata plus sampled raw transition images; legacy ASCII and region tools retained
modes.replace: metadata plus sampled raw transition images; legacy ASCII, reminder prose, and model-facing region tools suppressed

visual_transition_trigger: every nonterminal action with more than one engine-returned frame
visual_transition_sampling: k=min(n,8,max(2,ceil(log2(n)))) returned frames; pin returned frame 0 and returned frame n-1 and distribute interiors uniformly
visual_transition_labels: action number and display name, total returned frames, visibly changed frames, and exact zero-based sampled indices
reasoning_trace_position: the transition observation is prepended to the next analyzer user message after the action-bearing assistant/tool exchange and before the model's next reasoning step
current_grid_relation: the prior user turn contains the pre-action grid; the new transition block contains the sampled returned frames; the following current-grid image is the exact settled state
batch_safety: the proven guarded long-animation batch pause remains enabled in every mode
image_encoding: native ARC palette PNG rendered through the existing MULTIMODAL_UPSCALE=4 path
visual_image_token_estimate: 72 tokens per transition image for context bookkeeping (64 visual tokens plus wrappers), avoiding accidental base64-as-text history eviction
